patch_description: This update implements the "Budget-Scaled Probability" for redexes and the "Forced Variable Argument" rule (90% probability) to significantly boost `applied_lambdas` and `used_vars` metrics. It also refines the "Context-Aware Type Selection" to 85% and ensures the "Quadratic Recency Bias" is applied consistently across all variable selection points. The naming convention is updated to include depth for better uniqueness.
